fields.label: Event story
fields.sample:
Four years ago we walked through this gate with hesitant steps. We got lost in class schedules, became friends in the cafeteria and held each other up through exam weeks.
Today, as we toss our caps, we take with us not just a diploma but friendships that will last a lifetime. This yearbook is a small keepsake of those years.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample: Thank you to the professors who guided us, the families who stood behind us at every exam and the friends who were by our side every day. Here’s to the road ahead!

elements.name: Üst başlık
elements.text: The four-year marathon is over · Diplomas being handed out

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Four years, thousands of class hours, countless cafeteria breaks and a lifetime of friendship: our class gets ready to toss its caps.

elements.name: Kapak altyazısı
elements.text: Caps in the air, eyes on the future: our class together one last time before the ceremony.

elements.name: Haber başlığı
elements.text: Diplomas ready, caps in the air: after four years, the big day is here

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
This week the campus lawns are buzzing with a dif­fer­ent kind of ex­cite­ment. Stu­dents who timid­ly walked through the same gate four years ago are putting on gowns, straight­en­ing caps and gath­er­ing one last time for the class photo.
The stu­dent reps or­ga­niz­ing the cer­e­mo­ny say ev­ery­thing has been planned to the second, right up to the cap toss after the diplo­mas are handed out. The cafe­te­ria man­ag­er, mean­while, said it won’t be easy to bid farewell to the class that or­dered the most grilled cheese in four years.
As fam­i­lies race for the front rows, the pro­fes­sors have promised short speech­es. The grad­u­ates have just one wish: that these friend­ships last as long as their diplo­mas.

elements.text: Due to a size mix-up, some grad­u­ates will attend the cer­e­mo­ny in slight­ly long gowns, others in slight­ly short ones.

elements.name: Kısa haber
elements.text: No one miss­ing from the class list: for the first time, ev­ery­one will show up to class.

elements.text: “Every class with this group was a lesson for me too.”

elements.name: Söz

elements.text: Barely used textbooks. The underlined parts were on the exam — guaranteed.

elements.text: Caps up: the ceremony hour by hour

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Where does the procession start, when do the caps fly, where do families sit? Everything you need to know for the big day is on this page.

elements.name: Tören altyazısı
elements.text: Caps and laughter: the best shot of an era, from the ceremony rehearsal.

elements.name: Bölüm Kep atma kılavuzu · Adım adım
Adım notu Kepi sıkıca tutun
elements.text: Tassel starts on the right, moves left once you get your diploma.

elements.name: Adım notu Fotoğrafçıya işaret verin
elements.text: No tossing until the lens is pointed at you.

elements.name: Adım notu Üçe kadar sayın
elements.text: Everyone at once; whoever throws early buys the first round.

elements.name: Adım notu Başınızı koruyun
elements.text: Caps go up, but they always come down.

elements.name: Adım notu Kendi kepinizi bulun
elements.text: If you wrote your name inside, you’re in luck.

elements.name: Kılavuz notu
elements.text: Remember: button up your gown before the toss — then everyone laughs.

elements.name: Not
elements.text: The hall doors open an hour before the ceremony; the front rows fill up fast.

elements.name: Not
elements.text: Campus parking is limited; public transit and shuttles are recommended.

elements.name: Not
elements.text: Flowers after the ceremony, please; no balloons in the hall.

elements.name: Not
elements.text: No flash at diploma time; our photographer will capture each graduate.

elements.name: And metni
elements.text: I promise never to lose my curiosity, to share what I know, to save a spot for a friend in the cafeteria line, to pick up when this class calls on a hard day, and on every graduation anniversary to take out this paper and read it one more time.

elements.name: Hitap
elements.text: Dear us, ten years from now,

elements.name: Mektup
elements.text:
We hope we’re still laugh­ing at the same songs and meet­ing around the same table, even if only once a month. Some of our dreams have prob­a­bly come true, and some have been swapped for new ones; that’s fine. If we haven’t for­got­ten the plans we made on the campus lawns, the cold coffee we drank on finals nights and the laugh­ter after every exam, then all is well.
Maybe we’ve changed cities, maybe ca­reers. But may this class’s friend­ship never change. When you read this letter, pick up the phone and call some­one; chances are they’re call­ing you too.

elements.name: Arka fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: The city lights ahead of us: one class, a lifelong friendship.

elements.name: İmza Selin
elements.text:
Never change! Your cafeteria seat is always saved.

elements.name: İmza Mert

Couldn’t have survived finals nights without you.
— Mert

elements.name: İmza Derya
elements.text:
Same bench, ten years from now — promise!
— Derya

elements.name: İmza Kaan
elements.text:

— Kaan

elements.name: İmza Zeynep
elements.text:
Thanks for all your texts before every exam.
— Zeynep

elements.name: İmza Ece
elements.text:
Best of luck — don’t forget us when you’re famous!
— Ece

elements.name: Kehanet metni Mert

elements.name: Kehanet metni Zeynep
elements.text: Will keep being everyone’s shoulder to lean on.

elements.name: Anket notu
elements.text: The entire class took part in the poll. We have learned that most of those who an­swered “Still un­de­cid­ed” are ac­tu­al­ly plan­ning a world tour but haven’t told their par­ents yet.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Same campus, same lawns, same laughter. Date and place will be announced in the class group chat; no excuses accepted.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Dorm room with bunk bed and potted cactus. Be kind to the cactus.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Roommate in a new city. Must respect the dishwashing rotation.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Young graduate: fresh diploma, eager, caffeine-tolerant.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: One calculator. Has seen every final, still works.
